text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the first jewel of the 
Triple Crown. And the one to claim its 
inaugural glory was none other than—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin! It's Narita Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ow... My head hurts. Ah jeez, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I won...! Did you see that... you 
idiots who kept talking about a 'two-horse 
race'...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What was that race just now? What on earth 
was that feeling――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (A shiver—)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Her voice, her momentum. The sensation of 
being completely overwhelmed still lingers 
in my body...!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ! Ticket. You're—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...What if this were the Derby? I'd... 
lose..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Urk, waaaahhhhh~~!! No backing down!! 
Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become a Derby Umamusume! I'm 
gonna make my dream... come true...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since returning to the waiting room, 
Biwa Hayahide's expression has remained 
clouded.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. No need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Surely this is the result of my own 
hubris. No, perhaps there was simply a 
flaw in my equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Then for now, we should search for a 
solution that fits. No worries, an answer 
is bound to exist."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Because this must be a calculation error.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In other words, once the formula is 
corrected, there is nothing to fear. Even 
the vision of my defeat has vanished...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she speaks, Biwa Hayahide's voice 
gradually grows faint.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must have found some miscalculation... 
an unsettling factor serious enough to 
rattle her. However—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Ticket's sheer tenacity to squeeze out 
every last bit of energy. And Taishin's 
terrifyingly fierce late charge."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both possess top-tier finishing bursts. As 
expected... of those two.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Did something so 'unforeseen' really 
happen in this race?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. This data is something we 
could only obtain through defeat.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let us proceed with the re-analysis at 
once. There is very little time left 
before the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said, our next goal is the 
second leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
the Japanese Derby (Tokyo Yushun).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet as her words urged me along, I 
couldn't shake the feeling that the gears 
were slowly grinding out of alignment.
